retry_limit.unit: rechecks per stock decision per day
retry_limit.note: Recompute current reservations before retry; never bypass a check.

tie_threshold.note: a seed whose net differs by less than this from the store rule's is a tie; fixed before any run, never tuned (benchmark-not-target)

waste_price_info.note: the five-seed weekcheck's information column only; never a gate (RPT-05)
